snippet.title: Maliki: Poison Of the Past [GAMES] Launch Trailer
snippet.description:
Maliki: Poison Of The Past is now available !
Steam : https://store.steampowered.com/app/2893260/Maliki__Poison_Of_The_Past/?utm_source=youtubedescription
Ankama Launcher : https://www.ankama.com/fr/launcher
And on Nintendo Store! 
 
Join Maliki and her wacky family in their epic battle against Poison, a fearsome plant creature that has colonized space-time. Go along on a fantastic odyssey through the ages that provides a unique mix of exploration, temporal riddles and turn-based fights full of surprises.
